50501856.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human recombinant N-terminal His6 and Avi-tagged KEAP1 (321 to 609 residues) expressed in baculovirus infected sf9 cells by isothermal titration calorimetry

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Isothermal titra: ITC experiments were performed on a Microcal VP-ITC (Malvern Instruments Ltd.) at 25 °C in a buffer comprising 50 mM 4-(2-hydroxyethyl)-1-piperazineethanesulfonic acid (HEPES)-NaOH pH 7.5, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM TCEP and 5% DMSO. For all experiments compound was in the syringe and protein (human KEAP1 residues 321–609) was in the sample cell. Data analysis was performed using Origin 7.0 software. Heats of dilution were estimated using the final injections of each individual titration and subtracted before data analysis.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption - ITC data: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) data for compound 7 and its interaction with the Kelch domain (Kd reported in Table 1).
